items.title: Public comment and Q&A on the future work of the Reparations Task Force
items.summary: Residents can speak for up to two minutes at the virtual Reparations Task Force meeting about the Task Force's future work, including additional research on the period from 1620-1940. The public comment portion lasts 30 minutes.

items.title: Update on Phase 1 research and vote on additional research
items.summary: The Task Force will hear an update on Phase 1 research and vote on additional research covering 1620-1940.
items.skip_reason: Task Force discussion and vote, not open to public input; public input happens in the comment period.
